contentEn:
A completed family townhouse renovation in Burnaby in 2026 demonstrates what modern bathroom design actually looks like when built rather than rendered. The project covered two bathrooms, each with distinct finishes, incorporating glass shower enclosures, quartz countertops, LED lighting upgrades and a prefabricated vanity — features that consistently appear in the renovation inquiries Burnaby homeowners submit most.

Here is what those finishes cost in practice, what they look like installed, and what Richmond and Metro Vancouver renovation clients should expect when specifying each element for their own project.

Glass Shower Doors: Frameless vs Semi-Frameless in a Burnaby Townhouse

Glass shower doors divide opinions among Metro Vancouver renovators, and the 2026 Burnaby townhouse project shows why the distinction matters beyond aesthetics. A frameless glass door uses 10mm tempered glass with minimal hardware — hiding almost nothing — which means the tile work behind it must be finish-quality on all visible faces. The Burnaby project used 24-by-48-inch large-format porcelain tiles with aBookmatched pattern on the main bathroom feature wall, and the frameless glass enclosure made that pattern the design's centrepiece.

A semi-frameless door uses a thin aluminium channel at the top or bottom, reducing the glass thickness requirement and the hardware cost by approximately 35 percent. The second bathroom in the project received a semi-frameless unit, and theowners noted that the visual difference from the frameless door was negligible from a standing height but meaningful on the invoice.

Supply and installation for a frameless glass enclosure in Metro Vancouver 2026 runs $1,800–$4,200 per unit. Semi-frameless equivalents start at $900 and rarely exceed $2,400. Every unit requires a City of Burnaby building permit, and the glass must be permanently marked with the manufacturer's certification stamp — an inspection requirement the City enforces on every glass enclosure installation.

Quartz Countertops in a Family Bathroom: Why the Material Performs

Quartz countertop adoption in bathroom renovations across Metro Vancouver has accelerated since 2024, driven primarily by two performance characteristics: zero porosity and colour consistency. Unlike granite, which requires sealing and can show staining from haircare products, quartz resists moisture and chemical exposure without ongoing maintenance. The Burnaby project specified 2cm quartz in a warm white matte finish for both bathrooms — a common selection that reads as higher-end than the laminate alternatives without the maintenance overhead of natural stone.

Installed cost for a bathroom quartz countertop in the Metro Vancouver market in 2026: $85–$160 per square foot, depending on edge profile and whether the material is sourced domestically or internationally. The most frequently selected edge profile in 2026 renovation specs is a pencil edge or a轻微-eased ogee — the former for contemporary builds, the latter for transitional designs. The Burnaby project used a straightforward pencil edge throughout, matching the clean architectural line of the frameless glass.

Prefabricated Vanity vs Custom Millwork in a Burnaby Bathroom Renovation

The 2026 Burnaby townhouse renovation selected a prefabricated vanity for both bathrooms — a choice driven primarily by lead time and budget rather than aesthetic compromise. A custom millwork vanity in Metro Vancouver requires 6–10 weeks from measurement to installation, while aPrefab unit from a local supplier can be on site within two weeks of order. For renovating families who need both bathrooms operational within a compressed timeline, that four-to-eight-week differential is often the deciding factor.

Prefab vanities in the $800–$1,600 price point in 2026 feature solid hardwood frames, soft-close hardware and pre-drilled faucet holes — the same functional baseline as custom millwork at roughly 40–60 percent of the cost. The trade-off is storage volume: a custom unit can be specified to the exact centimetre of the available space, whilePrefab sizes are limited to standard dimensions (24, 30, 36 and 48 inches wide are the most available in Metro Vancouver inventory).

LED Lighting Upgrades in a Bathroom Renovation: What Actually Gets Specified

Every bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver in 2026 now includes LED specification as standard, but the quality differential between a $15 recessed fixture and a $85 architectural fixture is audible as much as visible — the better units use high-CRI LEDs (90+) that render skin tones accurately, which matters in a bathroom mirror. The Burnaby project specified 3000K warm white LEDs throughout, consistent with the warm-toned tile and quartz selections, and added a backlit mirror in the main bathroom as the primary ambient light source rather than overhead fixtures.

Total lighting package for a dual-bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver 2026, including pot lights, vanity lighting and backlit mirror: $1,200–$3,800. The electrical rough-in must be inspected by the City of Burnaby before drywall closing, and any circuit modifications serving wet locations require a licensed electrician — a requirement that applies regardless of whether the switch is smart or conventional.

Two-Bathroom Renovation Timeline for a Burnaby Family Townhouse

The Burnaby townhouse renovation ran eight weeks of active construction, completing both bathrooms within the same trade schedule to avoid two separate mobilisations. The breakdown: demo and disposal (days 1–3), plumbing and electrical rough-in with City inspection (days 4–12), tile and glass installation (days 13–28), countertop template and installation (days 29–38), and final fixture trades, electrical trim and commissioning (days 39–56).

Strata approval added three weeks before construction began — a requirement for any renovation in a Burnaby townhouse complex that involves plumbing or structural modifications. Homeowners considering a similar scope in a strata building should budget the strata approval timeline alongside the construction timeline when planning a start date.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cost of glass shower doors in Burnaby in 2026?

Frameless glass shower doors in Burnaby cost $1,800–$4,200 per unit installed in 2026, including permit and inspection. Semi-frameless units range from $900–$2,400. Both require a City of Burnaby building permit and must use certified tempered glass. The cost difference is primarily in glass thickness and hardware simplicity.

Is quartz better than granite for a bathroom countertop in Metro Vancouver?

Quartz outperforms granite in a bathroom environment because it is non-porous and requires no sealing. In Metro Vancouver's climate, where humidity levels fluctuate seasonally, quartz's dimensional stability — no cracking from moisture absorption — is a meaningful practical advantage. Cost is comparable at $85–$160 per square foot installed for either material.

How long does a two-bathroom renovation take in a Burnaby townhouse?

Active construction for a two-bathroom renovation in a Burnaby townhouse runs 6–10 weeks, plus 3–5 weeks for strata approval before work begins. The total timeline from contract signing to finished bathrooms is typically 10–16 weeks for a strata-titled property. Single-family homes with no strata requirement can begin sooner.

What is a prefabricated vanity and when should I choose one in a renovation?

A prefabricated vanity is a factory-built cabinet available in standard widths (24, 30, 36, 48 inches) with pre-installed hardware and pre-drilled faucet holes. Choose aPrefab vanity when lead time or budget is constrained — delivery is typically 1–2 weeks versus 6–10 weeks for custom millwork. The functional quality is comparable at the mid-range price point ($800–$1,600 per unit in 2026).

Why should I specify high-CRI LED lighting in a bathroom renovation?

High-CRI LEDs (90+) render colours accurately, which matters critically in a bathroom where mirror use is daily. Low-CRI LEDs can cast a greenish or bluish cast on skin tones, making grooming tasks harder to assess accurately. In the 2026 Burnaby townhouse project, 3000K warm white high-CRI LEDs were used throughout, paired with a backlit mirror as the primary ambient source rather than overhead fixtures.
contentZh:
2026年本拿比镇屋装修项目展示了一个现代浴室的实际建成效果。两名成人各用一间浴室，均采用玻璃淋浴间、石英石台面、LED照明升级和预制梳妆台——这些是本拿比业主询问最多的装修配置。

以下是在实际项目中的具体成本、安装效果，以及列治文和Metro Vancouver业主在指定每项配置时应该注意的事项。

玻璃淋浴门：本拿比镇屋的无框与半无框区别

2026年本拿比镇屋项目的主浴室使用了10毫米钢化玻璃无框门，隐藏的硬件极少，因此门后的瓷砖工作必须在所有可见面都达到饰面质量。浴室选用了24×48英寸大规格瓷砖，配合无框玻璃将花纹图案变成设计焦点。

半无框门在顶部或底部使用薄铝槽，减少玻璃厚度要求和硬件成本约35%。项目第二间浴室采用了半无框门，从站立高度看与无框门视觉差异不大，但在账单上差异明显。

2026年Metro Vancouver市场无框玻璃淋浴门供货及安装费用：每套$1,800–$4,200。半无框产品从$900起，一般不超过$2,400。所有装置均需本拿比市建筑许可，且玻璃上必须永久标注厂家认证标签——这是该市对每个玻璃装置安装的强制检查要求。

石英石台面在家庭浴室中的表现

石英石在Metro Vancouver浴室装修中的采用率自2024年以来加速增长，主要因为两个性能特点：无孔性和颜色一致性。与花岗岩不同，石英石不需密封，不会因美发产品而染色。本拿比项目选用了2厘米石英石暖白色哑光饰面，两间浴室统一配置——这是常见的高端选择，比层压板更具质感，同时无需打理天然石材。

2026年Metro Vancouver市场浴室石英石台面安装费用：每平方尺$85–$160，视边型设计和材料来源地（本地或进口）而定。最常见的边型是 pencil edge，适合现代风格；轻微圆弧ogee边型适合过渡风格。本拿比项目全程采用简洁的 pencil edge，与无框玻璃的干净线条相呼应。

预制梳妆台vs定制细木家具

2026年本拿比镇屋装修两间浴室均选用了预制梳妆台——这一选择主要由交货期和预算驱动，而非审美妥协。Metro Vancouver的定制细木梳妆台从测量到安装需要6–10周，而本地供应商的预制装置从下单到运达现场仅需两周。对于需要在压缩时间内同时完成两间浴室装修的家庭，这四到八周的差异往往是决定因素。

2026年$800–$1,600价格段的预制梳妆台采用实心硬木框架、缓冲关闭硬件和预钻孔龙头孔——与同价格段定制细木家具的功能品质相当。差距主要在储物空间：定制装置可精确到可用空间的每一厘米，而预制产品限于标准尺寸（本拿比Metro Vancouver库存最常见的是24、30、36和48英寸宽）。

LED照明升级：实际指定配置

2026年Metro Vancouver每个浴室装修项目都将LED specification列为标准，但$15的嵌入式灯具与$85的建筑灯具之间的质量差异不仅体现在视觉上。高显指LED（90+）准确呈现肤色，这对日常使用浴室镜很重要。本拿比项目全面选用了3000K暖白色灯具，与瓷砖和石英石的暖色调相匹配，并在一楼主浴室添加了背光镜子作为主要环境光源，而非天花板灯具。

2026年Metro Vancouver双浴室装修照明全套费用，包括筒灯、梳妆台照明和背光镜子：$1,200–$3,800。电气布线必须在干墙封闭前接受本拿比市检查，为湿区服务的任何电路修改均需持证电工——无论开关是智能还是传统型，这一要求均适用。

本拿比家庭镇屋两间浴室装修时间表

本拿比镇屋装修实际施工历时八周，两间浴室在同一工期内完成，避免了两次单独进场。进度分解：拆除和处置（第1–3天）、管道和电气布线和市府检查（第4–12天）、瓷砖和玻璃安装（第13–28天）、台面模板和安装（第29–38天）、最后设备、电气收尾和调试（第39–56天）。

施工前审批增加了三周时间——这是对本拿比镇屋综合体任何涉及管道或结构修改装修的强制要求。在分层物业考虑类似范围的业主，在计划开工日期时应将分层审批时间纳入装修时间表。

常见问题

2026年本拿比玻璃淋浴门价格是多少？

本拿比无框玻璃淋浴门2026年含许可和检查的安装费用为每套$1,800–$4,200。半无框装置价格为$900–$2,400。两者均需本拿比市建筑许可，且必须使用认证钢化玻璃。成本差异主要在玻璃厚度和硬件复杂性。

石英石与花岗岩哪个更适合Metro Vancouver浴室台面？

石英石在浴室环境中性能优于花岗岩，因为它无孔且无需密封。在Metro Vancouver的气候条件下，随着季节性湿度变化，石英石的尺寸稳定性——不因吸湿而开裂——是实际的重要优势。两者的安装成本在每平方尺$85–$160的范围内相当。

本拿比镇屋两间浴室装修需要多长时间？

本拿比镇屋两间浴室装修的实际施工时间为6–10周，施工前分层审批额外需要3–5周。从合同签订到两间浴室完工，对于分层产权物业通常需要10–16周。没有分层要求的独立屋可更快开工。

什么是预制梳妆台，什么时候应该选择它？

预制梳妆台是工厂制造的柜体，有标准宽度（24、30、36、48英寸），预装缓冲硬件和预钻孔龙头孔。当交货期或预算受限时选择预制梳妆台——通常下单后1–2周送达，而定制细木家具需要6–10周。中档价位（2026年每套$800–$1,600）的功能品质相当。

为什么要在浴室装修中指定高显指LED？

高显指LED（90+）准确呈现颜色，这对每天使用浴室镜至关重要。低显指LED会在皮肤上投射绿色或蓝色色调，使仪容任务更难准确评估。在2026年本拿比镇屋项目中，全面选用了3000K暖白色高显指灯具，并使用背光镜子作为主要环境光源，而非天花板嵌入式灯具。
